rounds.response: That log shows Windows is denying write access to that exports folder (permissions or a file lock). First test: try exporting to C:\Temp or your Desktop — if that works, it confirms folder-permission issues. To fix the folder: right‑click C:\Users\me\Documents\MyProject\exports → Properties → Security → Edit → select your Windows user and Allow Full control; if you can’t change permissions, click Advanced → Change (owner) and set it to your user, check “Replace owner on subcontainers and objects,” and apply. Also verify there isn’t an existing temp.pdf that’s read‑only or open by another app (delete it if present), and check Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Ransomware protection → Controlled folder access (turn off or add our app to allowed apps). Try again and, if it still fails, paste the new ExportFailed log line here.
